_comment_purpose: Opt-in Gonka hybrid profile. Keep premium Brain (default), switch coder and reviewer to validated Gonka models via the gonka provider registered by extensions/brain-workflow.ts.
_comment_enable: Either run `pi --workflow-profile gonka-hybrid` for a one-off session or set `profile: "gonka-hybrid"` here (or globally in ~/.pi/agent/workflow.json) to make it the default for this project. Alias `premium-brain-gonka-workers` is also accepted.
_comment_env: Requires GONKA_BROKER_API_KEY in the environment (see README). GONKA_BROKER_URL is optional and defaults to https://node.gonka.lat/v1. The provider is registered unconditionally but the models are unusable without an API key.

coder._comment: Defaults from the built-in gonka-hybrid profile are already applied. Override any field here to win over the profile; other fields (tools, includeKarpathyGuidelines, instructions) keep the package defaults.

reviewer._comment: Defaults from the built-in gonka-hybrid profile are already applied.
